text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Fulham and Wolves at Craven Cottage!
Compared to their heights of last season, Fulham have made an inconsistent start to this campaign, coming into this game sitting in 15th place with just 12 points so far.
They've won just three of their Premier League games so far (D3 L6), and are without a win in their last four outings in the competition, drawing one and losing the other three.
Two of those victories have come at home, including their most recent - a 3-1 win over Sheffield United - though that was back at the start of October.
As for Wolves, after a slightly slow start to their own season, they're hitting their stride now.

They've lost just one of their last seven Premier League outings (W3 D3), though that defeat did come in their last away trip as they had a controversial penalty awarded against them in the dying moments which saw Sheffield United beat them 2-1.
Wolves come into this game on the back of an outstanding stoppage-time comeback which saw them beat Tottenham 2-1 before the international break.
Marco Silva makes two changes from the loss to Aston Villa two weeks ago, with Reed and Cairney both coming into the side.
Jimenez, who scored his first Fulham goal in that game, retains his place against his former side and Leno makes his 150th Premier League appearance.
De Cordova-Reid drops to the bench, while Joao Palhinha is suspended for accumulating five bookings this season.
There's just one change by Gary O'Neil to his side after their win over Spurs last time out, and it's an enforced one.
Craig Dawson is suspended, so he's replaced by Santiago Bueno, who has recovered from an ankle injury.
Lemina and Semedo have both overcome injuries of their own to start, while Doherty is fit enough for the bench after a hamstring issue.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Pereira gets the game under way for Fulham!
GREAT CHANCE! It's almost a great start for Fulham! They work it quickly upfield, with Pereira racing down the right before fizzing it in from the byline.
Jimenez is closest to it in the middle, but he completely misses the ball.
Wolves are dominating possession now, but it's all in front of their hosts.
You can see the intent is there to move it forward quickly, but they can't find a way through Fulham at the moment.
Reed tries to intercept a throughball, but his touch inadvertently sets up Bellegarde.
He's wiped out by Robinson just after poking it forward, but Leno rushes out of his box to stop Hwang from reaching it.
IWOBI SCORES! It's a lovely team move from Fulham! It starts with Iwobi as he cuts inside from the right before sweeping it out to Robinson on the opposite flank.
He plays a one-two with Willian before squaring it into the middle and putting it on a plate for Iwobi to guide it past Sa from the six-yard box.
1-0 Fulham!
Robinson spotted Willian in space out wide, but helped to keep the move alive by making the underlapping run, which wasn't picked up by any of the Wolves defenders.
GREAT SAVE! Iwobi fizzes a dangerous cross into the far post and Jimenez tries to catch out Sa from a tight angle but only wins a corner.
Pereira whips the set-piece into Cairney on the edge of the box, who hits the shot on the half-volley, and the keeper gets a strong hand to this one too.
Lemina is slightly unlucky to give away a free-kick as he gets in a tangle with Pereira.
The Brazilian steps up to take it, but curls his cross too close to Sa, who comfortably pulls it in.

Only Liverpool (12), Chelsea and Tottenham (both eight) have won more points from losing positions in the Premier League this season than Wolves (seven), three of which came last time out against Spurs.
Ait-Nouri is clipped as he tries to keep the ball in play and he rolls out, holding onto his ankle.
He looks to be in some discomfort as the medical team gives him treatment.
With him off the pitch, the game is able to continue.

OFF THE BAR! Wolves may be temporarily down to 10 men, but it doesn't hinder them! Lemina's throughball carves Fulham wide open through the middle, and Hwang races into the box before firing an early shot on goal.
Leno is beaten, but it smacks the bar.
Ait-Nouri is back on the pitch to help defend another Fulham corner as Pereira swings it into the box.
His delivery is poor again though as it's comfortably cleared by the first man.
Fulham look dangerous every time they go forward at the moment, and Iwobi gets his head up to spot a lot of runners into the box.
He overhits the throughball into Jimenez though, and it rolls harmlessly out.
Ream is the first name into the book after tugging back Hwang to stop him on the break.
Ait-Nouri only lasted about three minutes after receiving treatment on his ankle, but he can't carry on.
Doherty, who is only just back after a hamstring injury, is brought on in his place.
Wolves are just starting to up the pressure a little here now and are pushing Fulham deeper into their own half.
The visitors are staying patient, waiting for their moment.

CUNHA EQUALISES! It's another brilliant team goal! Wolves move it out from the back quickly, but after a series of one-touch passes to get it through midfield, the best bit of play comes from Bellegarde as he twists Robinson one way and the other before clipping it into the far post.
Cunha is unmarked, and he rises high to thump his header past Leno.
Bellegarde jinks this way and that, giving Robinson no chance of guessing where he's going.
When he gets a yard on the defender, he gets his head up to pick out a cross to Cunha at the far post.
It's all Wolves at the moment, who look a lot more settled now that they're back on level terms.
Fulham are dropping deep, unsure whether to press or block the space.
Fulham have the chance to play out from the back, but Reed clumsily gives away possession under pressure from Joao Gomes.
Lemina slides it forward for Doherty, who tries to pull it back to the midfielder, but it's cut out by Castagne.
Fulham keep looking to their right side to make something happen here, and Iwobi picks out Pereira ahead of him.
He's looking for Jimenez with his deep cross, but Bueno just takes it off his toe.
Wolves are crowding together in midfield, giving Fulham very little space to work in when they try to go forward.
So, Willian cleverly flicks it through a tight gap into the box, but none of his team-mates made the run.
Iwobi has scored four Premier League goals against Wolves, at least twice as many as against any other side in the competition.
Willian is just too quick, and the ball is gone before Joao Gomes steps on his foot trying to block the pass.
He's the first Wolves player into the book.
BLOCK! Toti Gomes slides in on Pereira to stop the run and almost tees up Jimenez for a shot.

text: Kilman is covering to take it off his toe, but he pokes it to Cairney, whose first-time shot is charged down by Lemina.
BLOCK! At the other end, Fulham just can't clear their lines from a corner, and Joao Gomes dribbles his way into the box.
When a loose touch gets away from him, Toti Gomes takes over, drilling a low cross into the far post.
Reed stops it from reaching Hwang.
Wolves are pressing high upfield, and though Fulham are keeping possession well, they can't get it into midfield.
Bassey eventually goes long to Cairney, but the visitors just as quickly drop into their compact shape.
Iwobi is still getting a lot of joy down the right, and this time, he fizzes a low cross onto the edge of the box.
Pereira gets too tight to Kilman as he tries to control it though, fouling the defender.
For all of their patient play, Wolves just seem to be lacking something in the final third at the moment.
They're moving it forward well, only for their attacks to break down with a final loose ball.
CHANCE! Robinson intercepts a throughball and knocks it back to Leno, who is immediately put under pressure by Lemina.
The forward nicks it off him, but can't get a sight of goal, and he can't get enough on his pullback to Doherty.
Into three added minutes here and Fulham are looking to take a lead into half-time.
Willian hooks a cross into the box towards Cairney, but Semedo tracks back to clear his lines.
HALF-TIME: FULHAM 1-1 WOLVES.
It's all square at the break, with Fulham and Wolves drawing 1-1.
It was a great start for the hosts, who went ahead just seven minutes in, with Iwobi starting and finishing a good move as he guided his shot home.
Cairney almost doubled their lead minutes later, only to be denied by a good save by Sa.
Hwang had a glorious chance to equalise on the counter but smacked the bar from outside the box.
Cunha did hit the back of the net though, thumping a bouncing header past Leno into the bottom corner.
Silva will have been pleased with how his side started the game, but they dropped off slightly after that.
They began to reassert themselves just before the break though, and he'll be hoping to pick up where they left off.
O'Neil wouldn't have been fazed by conceding so early with his team's knack for coming from behind.
They responded well to that, but didn't create too many chances, something the manager will want to improve in the second half.
Wolves get us back under way for the second half!
CHANCE! Wolves' aim is clear as they move it straight into the box from the kick-off.
Doherty hooks it onto the penalty spot where Cunha is waiting, but he glances his header wide of the far post.
SAVE! Cunha gets out of a tight spot with some neat footwork and touches it back to Lemina.
He takes it to the edge of the D before choosing to have a go himself, but he drags at his shot and Leno holds onto it.
Twice in this second half so far, Robinson has made darting runs down the left which none of the Wolves players have picked up.
His first cross was poor, but this one is drilled in, and Kilman has to stretch to stop it from reaching Jimenez.
Wolves have only won one of their six Premier League games this season when they've gone into half-time level (D2 L3), while Fulham have won three of their five such matches in 2023-24 (D1 L1).
GOOD SAVE! Castagne slid in to make a vital block at the near post, and the resulting corner is swung in by Lemina.
Cunha rises high to meet it at the far post, but Leno gets a strong hand behind the thumping header.
PENALTY TO FULHAM! Cairney flew into a clean challenge on Lemina to get Fulham on the attack, and when Pereira loses the ball, he takes over again.
He skips away from Semedo, with the wing-back just stepping on his foot, and after a moment's thought, the referee points to the spot.
VAR is having a very close look at the penalty incident to make sure there was contact from Semedo on Cairney.
After a lot of replays, they agree that the wing-back did step on the Fulham captain's trailing foot, and after a quick check to make sure there wasn't an offside, the onfield decision stands!
WILLIAN SCORES! Fulham are back in front! It's as cool as you like from the Brazilian, who takes his run up from the edge of the 18-yard box, but just stutters in front of the ball.
Once the goalkeeper shifts his weight to his right, Willian slides it down the opposite side of the goal, giving Sa no chance.
2-1 Fulham!
Wolves want a quick response, and just like at the start of the second half, they quickly work it into the box from the restart.
Hwang pulls it back to Cunha, but his low shot is held by Leno at the near post.
Wolves are making their second change here.
Bellegarde, whose clever footwork set-up the visitors' equaliser, is replaced by a striker in Kalajdzic.
Fulham break quickly on the counter, with Castagne leading the charge down the right.
He has bodies to aim for in the box, but he gets the cross all wrong as it sails out to Willian on the far side.
Willian has scored all six of his penalties taken in the Premier League - only seven players have a better 100 per cent conversion rate in the competition's history.
GOOD SAVE! Castagne plays a long pass over the top to Jimenez, who can't control it under pressure, and the loose touch bounces into Iwobi's path.
He has a free run at goal but takes his shot from the edge of the box, and Sa rushes forward to tip it over the bar.
Wolves are struggling to keep hold of the ball at the moment.
They're winning it back in good positions to stop Fulham from getting into the final third, but just as quickly losing it again in midfield.
SAVE! It's another wonderful throughball from Wolves, this time by Joao Gomes as he cuts open Fulham's defence to pick out Cunha.
He can't wrap his foot around the shot though and hits it straight at Leno.
PENALTY TO WOLVES! Bassey beats Kalajdzic to the ball, but his header loops back towards his own box.
Hwang gets between Robinson and Ream, with the latter clumsily crashing into the forward just inside the penalty area.
The referee points straight to the spot!
HWANG SCORES! And Wolves are level once more! It's an emphatic penalty from the South Korean as he steps up and fires his shot straight down the middle.
Leno is already diving and it flies over the goalkeeper's legs and into the back of the net.
Fulham's reaction to conceding that goal is to make a double change as they look to take the lead for the third time.
Jimenez is replaced by Vinicius.
And Wilson is brought on in place of Pereira.
WIDE! Castagne darts down the right once more before pulling it back to Cairney on the edge of the box.
He drops a shoulder to lose Toti Gomes and open up a pocket of space, but he rifles his shot just wide of the near post.
There's a bit of a scramble in the Fulham box as Doherty's cross isn't dealt with by Leno at the near post.
Hwang is caught on his heels and can't react to get on the loose ball before Ream clears his lines.
SAVE! Wolves are crowding bodies into their box, but Fulham are more than happy to keep trying their luck from range.
It's Iwobi who steps up this time, curling his shot through the crowd, but Sa holds onto it.
There's almost a nervy moment at the back for Wolves as Lemina knocks it back to Sa, not realising how close Vinicius is.
The keeper stays calm though, slotting it past the substitute to set the visitors on their way.
Wolves' final roll of the dice sees Doyle come on to replace Cunha for the remaining minutes.
It's late by Lemina as he steps across Cairney, stopping the Scotsman's run.
He's protesting his innocence, but the referee is showing him a yellow card.
Wolves just haven't been able to cope with the link-up between Willian and Robinson down Fulham's left in the second half.
Wilson also gets in on the act this time, spinning away from Bueno, but his cross is nowhere near a team-mate.
Vinicius goes down softly before reacting angrily when Kilman tells him to get up.
The forward leans his head in towards the Wolves captain as he squares up, and the referee has to show him a yellow card.
PENALTY? Willian dinks it over the top for Robinson, who pulls it back from the byline.
Joao Gomes' first touch is heavy and Wilson quickly gets across to nick it off him, tripping over the Brazilian's outstretched leg.
The home fans and players are asking the question, but the referee gives a shake of his head.
VAR will have a look at it though...
The board has gone up to say there will be seven added minutes, but there'll be more than that as VAR takes a long look at the potential Fulham penalty.
After watching all the angles, referee Michael Salisbury is asked to go over to the monitor.
PENALTY TO FULHAM! Joao Gomes can't control the ball as it bounces off his thigh, and he desperately stretches to try and stop Wilson from nicking it off him.
The Brazilian took out the man, and Fulham have another spot-kick!
WILLIAN SCORES AGAIN! Just like last time, the midfielder takes a long run-up from the edge of the box and hesitates just in front of the ball.
He doesn't catch Sa out this time, as the keeper dives the right way, but Willian's penalty is precise.
It's out of Sa's reach as it nestles into the bottom-left corner.
3-2 Fulham! Can they hold on this time?
Silva wants to see out this win, and he's bringing on defensive reinforcements to do it.
Cairney, who has had a great game in the middle of the park, is replaced by Lukic.
And after scoring what Fulham will hope is the winning goal, Willian goes off for Adarabioyo.
Fulham are doing a good job of keeping hold of the ball as they try to run the clock down.
They're still pushing forward, and Wolves just can't get close to their hosts at the moment.
The Fulham fans are asking for the final whistle, but there's going to be another couple of minutes yet after that long VAR check at the start of stoppage time.
The hosts are pressing Wolves high, trying to block their way into the final third.
CHANCE! Wolves win a free-kick on the right and Sa makes his way forward for what is surely the last chance.
Fulham can't clear their lines and Doyle pokes it back into the six-yard box.
Kalajdzic loses his bearings, but Robinson is there to block the cross on the line and hook it away.
FULL-TIME: FULHAM 3-2 WOLVES.
Willian's stoppage-time penalty ends Fulham's winless run as they beat Wolves 3-2.
It was an even first half, which ended with the teams level at 1-1.
Iwobi put the Cottagers ahead after just seven minutes before Cunha equalised with a thumping header 15 minutes later.
Hwang also rattled the crossbar between those two goals.
The story of the second half revolves around penalties.
Cairney won the first when he was tripped by Semedo, and Willian stepped up to wrongfoot the keeper and fire Fulham back into the lead.
At the other end, Hwang was clumsily bundled over by Ream in the box and fired his own spot-kick down the middle.
Then, in stoppage time, Fulham were awarded another by VAR after Joao Gomes desperately tripped Wilson, and Willian was on target once more as he squeezed it past Sa from 12 yards.
That's Fulham's first win in four, and it moves them up to 14th.
Next up for them is a trip to Anfield to face Liverpool.
Wolves suffer their second consecutive away defeat as they stay in 12th.
They travel to Arsenal at the weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
